description: Language-agnostic corpus of the schema parser projection: each case lists schema documents (with the hand-written TypeScript a leaf already declares), and per export the instances every implementation must accept (valid), refuse (invalid), the ones the normative schema accepts but a projection may refuse because it follows a declared type or a safe-integer rule (stricter), and the ones both admit although they carry a property the schema does not declare (tolerated: only where the schema leaves the object open, because the parser drops that property). An object states additionalProperties: false exactly where the projection must refuse an unknown property, so every verdict equals the verdict of an independent validator. A property with a default that the declared type requires is filled with that default when it is absent (defaulted: input and the value the parser returns), and a property the declared type marks optional is left absent.
